thread:
Maya R: Quick sync — optimize toolkit delivery, small ask. We just merged quant recs PR (https://github.com/redwood-inference/optkit/pull/487) but QA surfaced a regression on long-context chat workloads. cc @Kevin M (runtime). Can owners confirm a quick set of batching + cache TTL changes we should try in canary before rolling back? Thinking smaller batch_size + longer prefix cache. Details below.

Ajay P: Which exact regression/eval is failing? id?

Maya R: Eval is internal/evals/quant-longchat/2026-03-15 v2 — drop in 95th pct latency and coherence dip on 8k sequences. Regression alert: https://internal.reports/alerts/1298. The PR added KV compression; suspect interaction with kernel selection.

Lina K: I skimmed the PR — quant tables look OK. Quick isolation steps: try reducing `max_batch_size` 8 -> 4, increase `prefix_cache_ttl_s` 300 -> 900, and toggle `kv_compress` off to see if that's the cause.

Lina K: Example override for canary:
```
# suggested override config
batching:
  max_batch_size: 4
  dynamic_batching: true
caching:
  prefix_cache_ttl_s: 900
runtime_flags:
  kv_compress: false
```

Kevin M: Ack. I can push a runtime patch to force the canary to use the older kernel chooser (force `fused_attn_v1`) for the 8k path and apply Lina's overrides. I'll need an owner for the rollout window. Also I'll add extra tracing around KV decode to capture compression ratio.

Tom S: I can own the canary tonight 22:00 PT (US-West). I'll coordinate with eng-oncall. @infra-bot please schedule canary job and grab logs to the `optkit-canary` bucket.

infra-bot: Canary job created: job/optkit-canary-3925007777. Window: 2026-03-17 22:00-23:00 PT. Logs will stream to gs://optkit-canary/logs/3925007777. Notifying eng-oncall.

Ajay P: Also let's add a lightweight perf regression job to CI that runs the quantized model on 2 long-seq traces (1x 4k, 1x 8k) post-merge — will open a small PR to add that to `ci/perf/short`.

Maya R: Great. @Tom S please post canary results here (latency p95, top error classes, and whether coherence metric moves). If the regression persists after `kv_compress=false` + batch downsize, we'll proceed with rolling back PR #487.

Tom S: :thumbsup: I'll run the canary and report within +1h of finish with a short summary and attached logs. If I hit anything blocking I'll DM Kevin and Maya.

Kevin M: One more note — if canary shows instability, I'll enable auto-fallback to quant-uncompressed model variant for the dedicated pool to avoid user impact.

Maya R: Thanks team — appreciate the quick turn.
